article.headline: East Tennessee State defeats South Carolina Upstate 87-76
article.description: — Jaden Seymour and Quimari Peterson scored 28 points apiece and East Tennessee State defeated South Carolina Upstate 87-76 on Friday night.
article.linkText: East Tennessee State defeats South Carolina Upstate 87-76

categories.description: South Carolina Upstate Spartans @ East Tennessee State Buccaneers

event.description: South Carolina Upstate Spartans @ East Tennessee State Buccaneers

keywords: South Carolina Upstate Spartans @ East Tennessee State Buccaneers
article.story: JOHNSON CITY, Tenn. -- — Jaden Seymour and Quimari Peterson scored 28 points apiece and East Tennessee State defeated South Carolina Upstate 87-76 on Friday night. Seymour also contributed six rebounds for the Buccaneers (3-2). Peterson added five rebounds and five assists. Mister Dean led the Spartans (2-5) in scoring, finishing with 19 points, nine rebounds and three steals. Brit Harris added 13 points and Chico Johnson had 11 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
